perks.name: Spirit of the Filaments
perks.description: Casting an Empowering Rift will grant you Devour. Defeating a target while Devour is active grants class ability energy.
perks.exact:
Standing on Empowering Rifts created by the user grants Devour for 11 seconds. 
Exiting, and then re-entering the same Empowering Rift refreshes the duration of Devour.
Secant Filaments' Devour can be refreshed to 11 seconds.

While Devour is active:
Kills grant 10% Class Ability Energy.

item.name: Reaper
item.description: Shortly after using your class ability, your next weapon final blow spawns an Orb of Power.
item.exact:
On Class Ability Usage:
The next Weapon Kill within 10 seconds spawns an Orb of Power.

Orb of Power:
0.8% | 1.1% | 1.25% | 1.5% Super Energy.

Incurs a 10 | 5 | 1 second cooldown between Orbs.

By default, an Armor Charge stack is removed every 10 seconds if a Passive Mod is equipped.
